title: Round 20b: the black box from the split's start, PPO (arm A4, H6, stage 2)
description: Round 19b's black box started 0.554 below net1 v6's fixed rule and ended 0.22 to 0.39 below; the arm on net1 started at the rule (-0.008) and ended -0.040 to +0.017. Round 20a cloned the rule into the black box by DAgger, from the raw measurements alone, to 0.064 to 0.087 below it (exp-net2-r20a-clone-170). Round 20b continues each clone by seed with round 19's PPO unchanged (round 15's copies mixture, tau 1 s, 120 iterations; release model-net2-r20a-clones as init_actor, a new critic), so the black box and the arm on net1 differ in their inputs and in a start 0.06 to 0.08 apart, not 0.55.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r20b-$ARM-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg actor "$IN/a/ppo-r20a-raw-s$SEED.actor.pt" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .inputs = $arm | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .init_actor = $actor' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r20b-$ARM-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
